title: The Hours We Keep — illustration source inventory
recovery_method: The seven current illustrations are AI-assisted revisions of previously recovered artwork. The approved cover is retained; each of the six interior plates was individually revised for the ecological edition. Generated RGB PNG files are retained without raster postprocessing.
original_file_status: Current revised generated PNG containers are preserved. Previous recovered artwork and its provenance remain in Git history; revisions are not claimed to be pixel recoveries of earlier artwork.
